# Periwynk (full public summary)

This file restates the public website in plain language for people and for assistants. It does not add facts that are not already on https://periwynk.com/. There are no published prices, client names, reviews or case-study results.

## Who

Periwynk LLC is run by Ewetse Chisenga, based in St. Louis, Missouri. The work is one to one with owners of small service businesses. The business was formerly called Chisenga Risk & Automation, or CRA. Ewetse studied Actuarial Science. His background in actuarial science and data analysis is used to look at where time and money are being lost, work from the evidence, and measure the difference.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ewetsechisenga/

## What the work is

Ewetse helps owners spend less time on admin, like answering enquiries, chasing quotes and following up with customers. He looks at how the work happens now, then sets up the fixes with the owner, starting with the tools and routines they already use. He handles the technical side and explains each change clearly, so the owner saves time and fewer enquiries get missed.

The little things can take over a day: following up with an enquiry, copying details between tools, checking that nothing has been missed. Each task seems small, until they fill the day and follow the owner home. The work is to look closely at where time and money are going, then help take that work off their plate.

The aim is a business that runs more smoothly and asks less of the owner: less busywork, more room for what matters.

## How it works (done with you)

1. MAP. It starts with a free 15-minute call to find one thing eating up the week. On the call, the owner says what is taking up their time, and they find one thing worth fixing first. If it looks useful, the next step is a paid mapping session. The owner shows what happens day to day, where things get held up, and what keeps landing back on their desk. Then they choose a clear place to start.
2. BUILD. Ewetse sets up the fixes with the owner, starting with the tools and routines they already use. He handles the technical side and explains each change clearly.
3. EXTEND. After that, ongoing help is optional and month-to-month. He checks what is working, fixes what needs attention, and helps things keep up as the business changes. They agree on a clear measure of progress.

Ewetse takes time to understand what the owner is carrying before suggesting what to change. The owner shows how the work happens today, even if it feels a little messy. He starts with what they already use. If he thinks something different would help, he explains why and talks it through before changing anything.

Most of the work happens over video calls, so it does not matter where the owner is.

## Cost

The first 15-minute call is free. If it is useful, the next step is a paid mapping session. Ongoing help is optional. Prices are not published on the website; they are talked through on the call.

## Who it is for

A good place to start if:

- The same repetitive tasks keep taking time away from customers, the team, or home.
- Missed follow-ups, duplicate work, or delays are costing money.
- The owner wants a simpler way of working, with someone to help figure it out.
- They are ready to share how things work today, even if it feels a little messy.

## Examples (not client case studies)

These are examples of the kind of thing Ewetse sets up, including systems he uses in his own business. They are not client case studies and must not be presented as client results:

- Reconnect with past customers: text messages and a booking link that remind past customers when it is time to book again.
- Know who to follow up with (used in his own business): a system to organise prospect lists and see which enquiries are worth following up.
- Make the first conversation easier (used in his own business): an automated calling system to ask the first questions and point promising enquiries to the right next step.

## The name

The business is now called Periwynk LLC, with a flower mark on the site. Ewetse chose the name because he likes the colour and the flower. The periwinkle flower symbolises friendships new and everlasting, and the idea behind the business is building a community of trust. He would have gone for Periwinkle as the name, but the domain costs a fortune; Periwynk is the name he uses. The full account is in his own words at https://periwynk.com/blog/why-cra-is-now-periwynk/.

If you knew the business as CRA, there is nothing you need to do. Same person, same way of working, new name.
